payload.name: Authority
payload.fact: Authority is a persuasion principle where individuals are more likely to comply with requests from perceived experts or figures of authority.

provenance.title: Employing political persuasion to manage rapport: qualitative analysis of campaign leaflets in Sheffield Central constituency
provenance.quote_or_locus: Authority played a major role in influencing the functioning of the other principles in the rapport-management strategies
